title: Preserve the logical error that one common angle cannot calibrate away
statement: The actual native construction leaves memory drift forward while isolating a clean cubic logical bracket. A retained-sector fifth-order phase creates a worst-sector reduced-logical trace-distance error>=2.034212942 tau^2-O(tau^4) for the specified simpler family/common calibration. The sign-projected forward composition cancels that term without learning the sector, with completed error O(tau^4). The shorter irrational-ratio and longer integer-clock implementations have different paid timing/segment contracts.
